task.description: construct() -> a nonempty subset of [1,n=256], with no nonconstant four-term arithmetic progression. Maximize the number of distinct three-term arithmetic progressions (positive difference, counted once). Cardinality and ambient interval are both reported; finite-box restriction of the source extremal problem. Choose a subset of [1,256] with no four-term progression and maximize the number of three-term progressions. Unlike the paper, ambient height is fixed and cardinality varies; each result bounds f_{3,4}(|A|) from below.
